description:
You: press Approve on this task to let the agent merge https://github.com/example/web/pull/12, which adds one column to the database.

## What the agent will do

Nothing more: Approve turns on the pull request's auto-merge.

## What it changes

- **Downtime:** none for visitors to app.example.com.
- **Undo:** revert the pull request.

## How we'll confirm

- The pull request merges once its checks pass.

## If you decline

The pull request stays open.
